segmentTypes.title: Segment types
segmentTypes.subtitle: Press OK to change a type. It cycles through: skip automatically, show a skip button, off.

playback.title: Playback
playback.subtitle: Quality, speed and captions

quality.title: Video quality
quality.subtitle: Quality used when a video starts. The closest available one is used if needed.

codec.title: Video codec
codec.subtitle: Preferred codec. Any lets YouTube choose.

speedStep.title: Speed step
speedStep.subtitle: How much each speed button press changes the playback speed.

frameRate.title: Frame rate
frameRate.subtitle: Switch the TV's refresh rate to match the video.

pause.title: Pause during switch
pause.subtitle: Playback pauses for this long while the TV changes its refresh rate.

playback.pauseInBackground: Out-of-focus pause (also when menus or panels open)

captions.title: Captions
captions.subtitle: Turn captions on by default, and choose the language they use.

experimental.title: Higher resolutions (experimental)
experimental.subtitle: Lets YouTube offer resolutions above the TV screen size. Can stutter on limited TVs. Restarts the app when changed.

max.title: Maximum resolution
max.subtitle: Highest resolution YouTube may offer while the unlock is on.

panelShrink.title: Video size while reading
panelShrink.subtitle: Shrinks the video when the description or comments are open.
panelShrink.on: Shrink video for description and comments

size.title: Video size
size.subtitle: How large the video stays while a panel is open.

playerControls.title: Player controls
playerControls.subtitle: Extra buttons in the player. Turn on the first option to use the others.
playerControls.pipInsteadOfMini: Use picture-in-picture instead of mini player
playerControls.onePress: One-press remote mode (OK plays or pauses, left and right skip 10 s)

browsing.title: Browsing
browsing.subtitle: Thumbnails, previews and what appears on screen

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails and titles
thumbnails.subtitle: DeArrow shows community titles and thumbnails in place of clickbait. Service: dearrow.ajay.app

previews.title: Video previews
previews.subtitle: Plays a short preview when a video is focused.

hideWatched.title: Hide watched videos
hideWatched.subtitle: Hides videos you have mostly watched.

threshold.title: Watched threshold
threshold.subtitle: Videos watched past this percentage are hidden.

pages.title: Hide on these pages
pages.subtitle: Pages where watched videos are hidden.

browsing.longPress: Long press OK to add to queue
browsing.deArrowPeek: Long press shows the other title and thumbnail

startup.title: Startup page
startup.subtitle: The page AxoTube opens at launch.

sidebarItems.title: Hide sidebar items
sidebarItems.subtitle: Selected items are hidden from the sidebar.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Colours, clock, dimming and performance

text.title: Text colour
text.subtitle: Colour of the text in the interface.

dimming.title: Screen dimming
dimming.subtitle: Dims the screen when you stop interacting.

timeout.title: Dim after
timeout.subtitle: How long to wait before the screen dims.

appearance.performance: Performance mode (memory part applies after reload)

show.title: When to show
show.subtitle: Always, or only while no video is playing.

format.title: Time format
format.subtitle: 24-hour, or 12-hour with or without AM and PM.

position.title: Position
position.subtitle: Corner of the screen for the clock.

whosWatching.title: Who's watching menu
whosWatching.subtitle: Choose a profile when the app starts.

about.title: About AxoTube
about.scanMessage: Scan the QR code to open {{name}}.

welcomeMsg.title: Welcome to AxoTube
welcomeMsg.subtitle: Go to settings and click on AxoTube Settings for settings.
